claim_reviews.rationale: The dates 1988, 1989 and 1991 are stated by Adams, Haynes and Ayorinde respectively; the interval is explicitly an envelope of conflicting reported years, not a measured continuous production period.

Haynes and Okome describe Nnebue producing this title for Sola Ogunsola and equipment; Haynes 2011 specifies two VCRs and identifies electronics and blank-cassette trade. Equipment attribution and source-lineage caveat preserve differences.
Nnebue produced the film for Ogunsola and invested ₦2,000 per 1998 account; Haynes reports funding and cost. Contributions are appropriately broad and the attribution is retrospective.
The earlier text says a few VCRs, later article says two; neither specifies models.

Catalogue identifies same title, Yoruba VHS, NEK and the bracketed distributor and date; Ayorinde independently associates title with NEK and Oguntade names NEK as producer. The estimated date is edition-specific, not first release. Brackets remain caveated; physical copy and credits unavailable.
Production episode predates the estimated edition as a reported production episode, but overlaps in possible years; rationale explicitly notes year dispute. No global priority or sales claim.
Haynes and Okome attribute a nominal 2,000-naira investment to a personal communication; later Haynes reports the cost. Claimed status and money context prevent treating this as verified accounting.
Witness limitation identifies edition metadata, not examined cassette, and distinguishes estimated edition from production date.

Revised event and measure basis is sourced rather than self-reviewed; unresolved chronology, equipment, stage credits, duplication and retail follow the conflicting and incomplete sources. The 1997 communication was not itself inspected.

Source descriptions, excerpts, hashes and source-lineage notes correspond to inspected originals and metadata; limits are explicit. Exact PDF search-index opening was accessible even though direct publisher fetch was blocked.

WorldCat estimates are cataloguer-supplied; an edition match is supported by title, Yoruba, NEK and related testimony but physical copy was not verified.
